evidence_refs.exact_excerpt: The historical shell drives the rules tick through requestAnimationFrame, clamps each frame delta to 50 ms, updates the adapter, and cancels on cleanup.
The playing loop clamps frame delta to 50 milliseconds and applies tickRuneForgeChamber while both rules and UI remain playing.
Entering the legacy playing phase requests fullscreen, runs requestAnimationFrame, clamps each frame delta to 50 milliseconds, and ticks the game state.
While gamePhase is playing, the effect runs a requestAnimationFrame loop, clamps delta to 50, calls tickVillageGuardian for playing model state, and cancels the frame on cleanup.

WizardZombieGame.tsx game loop (lines 252-396) runs in requestAnimationFrame with dt clamped at 50ms, dispatches juice diffing (damage, score, penalty, adaptive response), updates screen-shake/damage-flash/shockwave-ring/floatingTexts, applies camera transform, and transitions to gamePhase='ended' when nextState.status === 'gameover'.

The React shell mirrored logic phases into UI phases 'start'|'playing'|'ended': victory/defeat triggered results computation (accuracy = correctWords/totalAttempts, XP via calculateXP) and exactly one onComplete report via hasReportedRef.
Historical victory or defeat creates a completion summary and estimated XP, enters ended UI once, and reports the result once.
On victory or gameover, the component computes accuracy and XP, stores results, invokes onComplete at most once through hasReportedRef, and changes the phase to ended.

The withdrawn cartridge update advances the model using delta and edition speed tuning, resolves normalized traversal actions after surface readiness, renders, and delivers completion once the model is complete.
A rules defeat computes local accuracy and XP, enters ended UI, exits fullscreen, and reports completion once.
The historical completion emitter guarded host completion and diagnostic callbacks with a local fire-once flag.
When historical gameState phase is victory or defeat, the effect calculates results and sets gamePhase to ended; a second effect calls onComplete once when ended results exist.
In ended phase with results and before hasReportedRef, the effect marks reported and calls onComplete(results).
createAbyssalWellState throws on empty sentences, picks one sentence via injectable RNG, splits term into words, and initializes phase 'start', player angle 1.5π (bottom of rim), 3 lives, no enemies.
createArchersRevengeState throws when vocabulary is empty.
The shared dependency rejected empty inputs and blank translations or terms and initialized deterministic targets, progress, score, counts, and incomplete state from the host seed.
State creation rejects an empty vocabulary, initializes one zero progress entry per vocabulary term, and chooses the initial target by random index.
State creation rejects empty vocabulary, selects a sentence through the RNG, splits its term into words, initializes three lives, zero progress, an empty object list, and the center lane.

State creation rejects empty vocabulary, uses an optional RNG for sentence selection and angle offsets, truncates words by difficulty, initializes health and a centered rune stone, and creates one circle per active word.

createRuneMatchState rejects empty vocabulary, shuffles the provided vocabulary, limits active vocabulary to six items, chooses a power word from the active vocabulary, and initializes status to selection with one shuffle and two hints.
The historical initializer parsed sentence input, rejected empty or blank content, built a seeded graph, and initialized at its origin.
Empty vocabulary throws Vocabulary cannot be empty.

taxonomy_entries.atomic_dimension: physical input to semantic action mapping

evidence_refs.exact_excerpt: Keyboard controls during play: ArrowLeft/A rotate counter-clockwise, ArrowRight/D rotate clockwise, Space/Enter fire (preventDefault); input ignored unless
The deleted scene wired WASD and arrow keys, Space firing, four pointer movement controls, and a pointer FIRE control.
Historical keyboard keys 1 through 9 select the corresponding active sentence block
Keyboard input accepts ArrowLeft/A and ArrowRight/D; pointer input is supplied by left/right buttons using onPointerDown.
The input adapter maps negative and positive dx/dy values to left/right/up/down booleans and maps cast truthiness to cast.
The withdrawn cartridge binds ArrowLeft or A and ArrowRight or D, lower-half left and right regions, and 55-pixel swipe threshold to traversal actions.
The Spacebar keyboard event triggers activateSpecialAbility via a window keydown listener
Ingredient groups are draggable and convert the final pointer position through the stage scale before dispatching
The primary battle input is a text input
Each active circle group wires both onClick and onTap to the same selection handler and adds an invisible enlarged hit circle.
The component registers keydown and keyup listeners for arrows and WASD, prevents default for recognized keydown inputs, updates pressed keys, and computes
The historical scene mapped left/forward/right to touch controls and Left/A, Up/W, Right/D keyboard handlers.
Legacy keyboard input maps ArrowLeft or A to left lane, ArrowDown or S to center lane, and ArrowRight or D to right lane while playing.
The historical Phaser scene binds Arrow/WASD movement and Space/Enter collection plus five normalized pointer regions for left, up, down, right, and collect.
Historical ticks add elapsed time, decay stability with a 250 ms clamp, and defeat on timeout or zero stability.
advanceDragonFlightTime clamps elapsedMs to durationMs and sets status 'boss' when elapsed reaches duration (lib lines 129-130).
advanceDragonRiderTime clamps elapsed time to durationMs and changes running to boss when the duration is reached; it ignores non-running states.
The main step returns terminal states unchanged, advances gameTime by dt, decreases timeRemaining by dt with a zero floor, and enters gameover when mana or time reaches zero.
Timer counts down from 60s every 1s while status='playing' and calls endGame() when it hits 0 (GameEngine.tsx lines 160-167).
Ticking decrements time, defeats on expired time or non-positive health, rotates circles by difficulty speed, and advances a level when target index reaches word count.
When the decremented timer is at most zero, the tick sets status to defeat and returns.

The shared dependency ignored inactive targets, counted live-target attempts, deducted score for wrong visible-token hits, and deactivated only the stable ID of a correct target while advancing ordered progress.

Historically, selecting the expected block advances progress, score, correct count, and stable placements; a wrong selection adds an unstable placement, error, and stability loss and may defeat at the preset limit.

A player-prisoner collision is detected when distance is less than the sum of their radii; an in-order prisoner is collected and appended to the trail, while an out-of-order prisoner flees for 1500 ms and the collected trail is rescattered and reset.

Collecting a correct book adds 10 mana subject to a zero floor, increments the target word's progress, restores one shield charge up to the player's maximum, and may select a next target when vocabulary is supplied.
A legacy obstacle or incorrect gate decrements lives and resets combo; a correct gate increments score, correct answers, combo, collected words, and target index, and the last word sets victory.
A newly collected orb is correct only when its orderIndex equals targetIndex; correct collection increments correctAnswers, appends the word, and increments

Dropping an ingredient removes it from the belt, binds an idle cauldron only when the first word matches its indexed waiting customer, advances exact next words while brewing, completes the full sequence, or enters warning on a mismatch.
Selection compares the circle word string with the current target word string; a match selects that circle and advances progress, while a mismatch subtracts health and may defeat.

On player overlap with an uncollected crystal, the state compares its word to words[targetIndex]; a correct word is marked collected, appended, and advances targetIndex, while a wrong word damages health and increments wrongAnswers without advancing
A nonfinal historical correct step advanced the token and current node, lit the target, added score/correct/attempt counts, and recorded a correct outcome.
A correct legacy collection removes the orb, appends its word, advances target index and combo, increments score and counters, and changes status to victory after the last word.

A historical correct selection adds 100 score and advances the target; exhausting the final sentence calls finish with victory true, otherwise it loads the next sentence and resets player and target index.
Up input opens the nearest closed door; the expected word advances progress and score, while a wrong/trap door removes a life and spawns a bat; opening also stuns ghosts within 50 units
The correct-order branch marks the collided villager collected, increments correctAnswers and targetIndex, appends its word, and appends one trail object.

calculateXP: 0 XP if no attempts; accuracy = correctWords/totalAttempts; base XP = correctWords; +2 perfect accuracy, +1 survival (lives/initial >= 0.5), +1 speed (gameTime < 30s); total clamped to max 10.
Results calculate accuracy from correctAnswers and totalAttempts and calculate XP as floor(correctAnswers multiplied by accuracy), returning score, counts, gameTime, and difficulty.

XP calculation returns zero for zero attempts, uses correctAnswers divided by totalAttempts for accuracy, adds bonuses for perfect accuracy, mana ratio at least one-half, and gameTime below 60000 ms, and caps the result at ten.
The XP formula on the advantage-games page handler is Math.floor(results.correctAnswers * results.accuracy).
Local XP uses capped completed-sentence base XP plus accuracy, reputation, speed, and progression bonuses, capped at ten.
calculateRpgBattleXp computes healthRatio (weight 0.6) + turnEfficiency (weight 0.4) + streakBoost (up to 0.2), maps the clamped score to round(1 + score * 9), and clamps the result to 1..10 XP.
Local XP adds per-correct-word base XP and accuracy, speed, and survival bonuses, capped at maxXP.
calculateXP computes baseXP from correctAnswers, conditionally adds configured accuracy, speed, and survival bonuses, then returns the lesser of maxXP and baseXP plus bonus.
